decisions.reason: It remained on the website through 2024 and, as a complementary coolant-system upgrade for an established machinery supplier, it is likely to stay unless demand proves too narrow.
The centrifuge still appears in 2024 and fits a higher-value coolant management portfolio, so a large German machinery firm would usually continue it unless sales or service complexity disappoint.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is a standard adjacent product for machine-tool support and its continued listing after the first launch year suggests it has viable market acceptance.
The hinged belt chip conveyor appears to be a core, broadly applicable conveyor variant and is therefore the least likely among the remaining products to be withdrawn soon.
